message: Not too long ago, I was at my grandson's soccer game, totally immersed in the excitement. Just as his team was about to score, my phone decided it was time to die. No emergency contacts, no game photos, nothing! 😅 It reminded me how important it is to have a few backups—whether it’s a simple list of important numbers or keeping documents handy. Sometimes, it’s the little things that keep us connected when technology fails. Have you thought about what you’d do if your phone went silent?
